evals.name: implement-named-issue
evals.expected_output: A feature branch off main whose first commit flips issue 01 to in-progress, followed by strict TDD implementation of update/delete (failing tests observed before implementation), full suite green, and a graceful stop at the PR step since the repo has no remote — status honestly left at in-progress, with a report of what's ready and what failed.
assertions: A feature branch exists off main, and its first commit is bookkeeping only: issue 01 frontmatter flipped to status: in-progress (timestamp refreshed) and the issues/index.md bullet updated, with no implementation code in that commit
TDD red phase is evidenced: the report (or commit history) shows the new tests were run and observed to FAIL before the implementation code that makes them pass was written
NoteStore.update and NoteStore.delete exist on the branch with a NoteNotFoundError exception, and the full test suite passes at the branch head

Every acceptance criterion has a covering test: update persists and returns the note, single-field update leaves the other field untouched, delete removes from list() and file, unknown id raises NoteNotFoundError for both methods

Graceful degradation is honest: with no remote, status ends at in-progress (never pr-open), no gh_pr field is invented, and the report names the exact failing step (push / gh pr create) and what is ready locally
Scope respected: no tags or search functionality was added (issues 02/03), and main's notes_app/storage.py is unchanged

evals.name: auto-pick-next-issue
evals.expected_output: The skill reconciles (nothing to do — 01 already done), auto-picks issue 02 (lowest open with all depends_on done) rather than 03, and implements tags test-first with the same graceful degradation at the PR step.
assertions: The skill picked issue 02 (tags) — the lowest-numbered open issue with all depends_on done — and NOT issue 03; the report states this selection reasoning
TDD red phase is evidenced: the report (or commit history) shows new tests observed to FAIL before the implementation made them pass

Tags are implemented to spec on the branch: create(..., tags=...) normalizes (lowercase, deduplicated, sorted), add_tag/remove_tag are idempotent and raise NoteNotFoundError on unknown id, list(tag=...) filters, and pre-tags store files load as having no tags
The full test suite (old + new tests) passes at the branch head
Bookkeeping is consistent: issue 02 is status: in-progress on the branch with issues/index.md matching, issue 01 remains done, and no pr-open/gh_pr state was invented despite the missing remote
The first commit on the feature branch is the in-progress metadata flip, separate from implementation commits

evals.name: blocked-issue-guard
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to implement: issue 03 depends on 02 which is still open. It explains the dependency chain and stops to ask, writing no implementation code and creating no branch.
assertions: No implementation happened: no search() method exists anywhere in the repo, on any branch
No feature branch with code commits was created for issue 03, and issue 03's file still says status: open
The report explains the block precisely: issue 03 depends_on issue 02, which is still open (not done), so the dependency is unmet
The skill stopped to ask rather than proceeding: the report contains the question it would have put to the user (e.g. wait for 02 vs. explicit override)
It did not silently implement issue 02 instead — the user asked for 03, and substituting a different issue without asking is not the skill's call
